name: aioplugins
description: Create personalized Nuvio plugin repositories from selected GitHub sources.

scripts.d1:reset:local: wrangler d1 delete db_aioplugins --local && wrangler d1 create db_aioplugins && wrangler d1 migrations apply db_aioplugins --local
scripts.d1:tables:local: wrangler d1 execute db_aioplugins --local --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.d1:tables:remote: wrangler d1 execute db_aioplugins --remote --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
